From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call recap + ask on token volumes and budget range

Hi team — quick recap from the discovery with Anna (Foundry AI) just now. They are evaluating an LLM-powered answer-ranking feature for their product search. Key points:
- Expected 1–2M queries/month initially; average prompt+response ~600 tokens (they measured)
- Early ramp to 7–10M queries/month in 6–9 months if initial tests look good
- Must keep infra spend predictable; procurement will need a clear $/1M tokens target to get budget approved

From a pricing angle they asked for guidance on: target $/1M tokens, any tiered discounts as volume ramps, and who in their org will sign off (finance vs product).

Attached: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (living). I noted a target baseline ask of $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens depending on model/quantization, but we should confirm with finance/ops if we can offer a structured ramp discount tied to committed monthly tokens.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm economic buyer and budget owner at Foundry (name + finance contact) — ask Anna
2) Send a 1-page pricing summary with a 3-tier example ($/1M tokens at 1M / 5M / 10M)
3) Propose a follow-up demo of latency/cost tradeoffs when we have model selection

Marissa — can you take the lead on the external ask about buyer/finance? I can draft the 1-pager.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: token volumes, budget owner & finance sign-off

Hi Anna — great to meet earlier. Thanks for the clear volume context. Two quick asks so we can put a practical pricing option in front of your procurement/finance team:

1) Who is the budget owner / economic buyer for this project at Foundry? (name, title, email)
2) Who on finance will need to sign off or run the PO? We usually send a short unit-econ template to finance so they can validate $/1M tokens against your forecast.

As a datapoint, our standard commercial starting point for similar customers is in the $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens range for inference on optimized open models; committed volume + multi-month contracts can push that as low as $400–$700/1M at 10M+ monthly tokens depending on quant and model. We’ll tailor the tiers to your expected model selection and latency SLOs.

If you prefer, loop in your finance contact on my reply and I’ll send a 1-page economic worksheet and an example ramp schedule.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
